row.evidence: Less Annoying CRM sells one plan at $15 per user per month ("No tiers... Just one price that includes everything"); its help centre, security centre and API docs document no SAML SSO or SCIM, and the API's Users functions only read users (GetUser, GetUsers).
row.notes: New row. Single plan: $15/user/month plus tax, all features, no tiers; the pricing page shows only a monthly price, so it is recorded as monthly. Users are added and deleted by admins in the app (deletion reassigns records; deleted users can be restored). No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM or JIT documented (sitemap 1,213 URLs incl. 431 help pages; security centre; API docs). The v2 API is function-based (GetUser, GetUsers; CreateTeam/EditTeam/DeleteTeam/GetTeam/GetTeams with UserIdList) and cannot create or remove users. Okta OIN app is SWA only (2013); no Microsoft Learn tutorial. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Everything included
plans.price_text: $15 per user per month + applicable tax
plans.notes: Only plan; no annual price shown.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML SSO or provisioning documented in the help centre, security centre or API docs. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: List users visible to the caller (admins see all)

limitations.text: The Users functions are read-only (GetUser, GetUsers); no create, update or delete user function is documented.

user_api.notes: The API is function-based: docs give function names, not HTTP paths, so endpoints use method 'RPC'. DeleteTeam, GetTeam and GetTeams also exist. Authentication details were not captured (the Getting Started subpages redirected to the Introduction).

okta.notes: OIN app marks SWA only (read from page markup).
